revised_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final pure raster PNG for iOS app icon and App Store icon, square 1024x1024
Primary request: Create a clean final app icon for the Chinese iOS app "步履小屋". The icon must be a full square image with no inner rounded rectangle.
Subject: One very large cozy tiny cabin filling most of the square image, with a warm lit door/window. Add exactly one pair of footprint marks near the lower foreground and one clean folded paper plane, enlarged, near the upper-right roof area. No other objects.
Style/medium: premium simplified watercolor travel-journal icon, iconic and readable, soft pencil outline, warm paper texture, crisp silhouette.
Composition/framing: use the full square canvas efficiently. Full-bleed warm cream/paper background across the entire square, not a rounded card. Cabin should occupy about 80-88% of the image area while staying safe for iOS rounded-corner crop. Paper plane and footprints should be clearly visible at phone icon size. No tiny details.
Lighting/mood: warm, cozy, calm, inviting.
Color palette: warm cream full-canvas background, honey yellow cabin light, warm brown roof/walls, muted sage/olive only on the roof if needed. Absolutely no blue, no purple, no dark navy.
Materials/textures: subtle watercolor and paper grain; clean crisp edges; not blurry.
Text: no text, no letters, no numbers.
Constraints: pure square image; full-bleed background; no visible inner rounded rectangle, no white corner cutouts, no border, no exterior drop shadow. Exactly one pair of footprints; keep one paper plane. No leaves, flowers, grass, trees, plants, scenery, clouds, Apple logo, Health icon, watermark.
